```{r}
VNCIS1=templatebrain("VNCIS1", dims = c(1024,768,163), voxdims = c(0.43,0.43,1), units = "microns")
MANC_MANCsym <- here::here("v1/Common/registrations/MANC_MANCsym.list")
MANCsym_VNCIS1 <- here::here("v1/Common/registrations/MANCsym_VNCIS1.list")

safe_read_mesh <- function(x) {
  tryCatch({
    malevnc::read_manc_meshes(x)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Skipping missing mesh: ", x)
    return(NULL)
  })
}

safe_read_neuron <- function(x) {
  tryCatch({
    malevnc::manc_read_neurons(x)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Skipping missing neuron: ", x)
    return(NULL)
  })
}

neurons_to_nrrds <- function(bodyids = c(16856),
                             refbrain = VNCIS1,
                             via = MANC_MANCsym,
                             reg = MANCsym_VNCIS1,
                             direction = "forward",
                             mesh = TRUE,
                             filename = "neurons_to_nrrds.nrrd") {
  
  if (mesh) {
    message("Reading meshes safely...")
    ns <- lapply(bodyids, safe_read_mesh)
    ns <- Filter(Negate(is.null), ns)
    ns <- as.neuronlist(unlist(ns, recursive = FALSE))
    ns <- ns / 1000
  } else {
    message("Reading neurons safely...")
    ns <- lapply(bodyids, safe_read_neuron)
    ns <- Filter(Negate(is.null), ns)
    ns <- as.neuronlist(unlist(ns, recursive = FALSE))
    ns <- ns / 125
  }
  
  if (length(ns) == 0) {
    stop("No valid neurons or meshes could be read. Aborting.")
  }
  
  if (!is.null(via)) {
    message("Applying via and final transformations...")
    ns.symm <- xform(x = ns, reg = via, direction = direction)
    ns.trans <- xform(x = ns.symm, reg = reg, direction = direction)
  } else {
    message("Applying single transformation...")
    ns.trans <- xform(x = ns, reg = reg, direction = direction)
  }
  
  im3 <- as.im3d(xyzmatrix(ns.trans), voxdims = refbrain)
  write.im3d(im3, file = filename)
}
```

```{r load manc metadata all birthtimes}
# ============================================================
# LOAD MANC METADATA
# SAVE 04B T1/T2/T3 x LEFT/RIGHT
# ============================================================

library(malevnc)
library(dplyr)

malevnc::choose_malevnc_dataset("MANC")
options(malevnc.neuprint_dataset = "manc:v1.2.3")

mancAnnotations <- malevnc::manc_neuprint_meta()


# ============================================================
# SETTINGS
# ============================================================

neuromeres <- c("T1", "T2", "T3")

# Check exactly how side is encoded in MANC
#print(
  #mancAnnotations %>%
#    filter(hemilineage == "04B") %>%
 #   count(somaNeuromere, somaSide)
#)


 # somaNeuromere somaSide  n
  #          T1      LHS 97
    #        T1      RHS 98
   #         T2      LHS 92
     #       T2      RHS 95
     #       T3      LHS 89
     #      T3      RHS 91


# ============================================================
# LOOP THROUGH T1/T2/T3
# ============================================================

for (seg in neuromeres) {

   # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # LEFT
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  left_04B <- mancAnnotations %>%
    filter(
      hemilineage == "04B",
      somaNeuromere == seg,
      somaSide == "LHS"
    )

  cat(
    "\n====================================\n",
    seg, " 04B LEFT\n",
    "Neurons: ", nrow(left_04B), "\n",
    "====================================\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  print(
    table(
      left_04B$birthtime,
      useNA = "ifany"
    )
  )

  write.csv(
    left_04B,
    paste0(
      "MANC_",
      seg,
      "_04B_left_metadata.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # RIGHT
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  right_04B <- mancAnnotations %>%
    filter(
      hemilineage == "04B",
      somaNeuromere == seg,
      somaSide == "RHS"
    )

  cat(
    "\n====================================\n",
    seg, " 04B RIGHT\n",
    "Neurons: ", nrow(right_04B), "\n",
    "====================================\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  print(
    table(
      right_04B$birthtime,
      useNA = "ifany"
    )
  )

  write.csv(
    right_04B,
    paste0(
      "MANC_",
      seg,
      "_04B_right_metadata.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

```
